items.question: In what sequence must the previously stated pentad of seed-syllables be arranged?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate five seed-syllables in a specific sequence.
The term vyutkramāt explicitly indicates reversal of that sequence.
The previously stated pentad is the object to be arranged.
items.inference: The previously stated pentad of seed-syllables must be taken in reverse order.
items.plain_english: O Supreme Goddess, take the previously stated group of five seed-syllables in reverse order.
